recipes.title: Toffee Peanut Candies with Sea Salt
recipes.description: Luxury toffee candies with roasted peanuts and sea salt finish
instructions: Line baking dish with greased parchment paper
Melt butter and sugar in thick-bottom saucepan, stir until golden brown and thermometer reaches 150°C
Add peanuts carefully, stir and pour over parchment, flatten evenly
Let harden 1 minute, sprinkle chocolate, wait 1 minute, spread evenly
Sprinkle sea salt on top, cool 45 minutes, cut into cubes

recipes.title: Cosmopolitan White Chocolate Cocktail
recipes.description: Elegant cocktail featuring white chocolate and cranberry
instructions: Bring milk to boil in thick-bottom saucepan
Pour hot milk over white chocolate in heat-proof bowl, wait 1 minute, whisk well, let cool
Pour Quantro, vodka, cranberry juice, lemon juice and chocolate sauce into shaker with ice
Shake well, pour into tall glasses and serve

recipes.title: Cat Tongues - Chocolate Dipped Cookies
recipes.description: Delicate cookies dipped in chocolate with pistachio garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C, line baking dish with greased parchment
Sift flour and salt together
Beat egg whites with 1 tbsp sugar until shiny and stable
Beat yolks with remaining sugar until thick (5 min), add lemon juice and vanilla
Fold flour into yolk foam, then fold in egg whites until uniform
Pipe 10cm strips on parchment with 1cm tip, bake 10 minutes until golden
Dip cookies in melted chocolate, sprinkle pistachios and coconut, cool
Dust with powdered sugar before serving

recipes.title: Yogurt White Chocolate Strawberry Milkshake
recipes.description: Refreshing milkshake with white chocolate and fresh strawberries
instructions: Boil milk with mint, remove from heat, let absorb 10 minutes
Remove mint, add chocolate to milk, wait 1 minute, stir until smooth, cool to room temperature
Blend strawberries, white chocolate cream, yogurt and ice cubes in high-speed blender
Serve in tall glasses with tablespoon of ice cream on top

recipes.title: French Hot Chocolate - Very Thick
recipes.description: Luxurious thick hot chocolate with sweet whipped cream
instructions: Mix cornstarch with glass of milk in metal bowl, whisk until dissolved
Add sugar and yolks to cornstarch mixture, whisk until uniform
Boil 2 cups milk with vanilla in saucepan, remove vanilla stick and scrape grains back in
Slowly add hot milk to yolk mixture while whisking, place over fire and stir until boils
Remove from heat, pass through sieve
Add dark chocolate, bring remaining milk to boil and add to chocolate mixture, stir until smooth
Pour into cups, top with whipped heavy cream and serve hot
